# Grid-Based Logic Game Taxonomy

## 1. Number Placement & Constraint Games
*Games centered on placing numbers according to mathematical or positional rules*
- Sudoku
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Juosan

## 2. Region Division & Partitioning Games
*Games where the grid must be divided into defined shapes or areas*
- Fillomino
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Double Choco
- Evolomino
- Nuritwin
- Choco Banana

## 3. Path & Loop Drawing Games
*Games requiring the construction of continuous paths or closed loops*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Numberlink
- Hebi
- Nagareru
- Suraromu
- Mid-loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Dotchi-Loop
- Pencils

## 4. Region Painting & Shading Games
*Games where cells must be shaded or colored according to specific rules*
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Hitori
- Kurodoko
- Tilepaint
- Nurimeizu
- Norinori
- LITS
- Usowan
- Kurotto

## 5. Object Placement Games
*Games requiring placement of specific objects or symbols within the grid*
- Akari
- Hashiwokakero
- Yosenabe
- Chained Block

## 6. Shape & Diagonal Orientation Games
*Games involving geometric shapes, diagonal elements, or directional cell logic*
- Shakashaka
- Sashigane
- Nurimisaki
- Sto-stone

## 7. Movement & Gravity-Based Games
*Games involving sliding, movement, or gravitational logic applied to grid elements*
- Satogaeri
- Yajilin
- Nagareru *(reclassified — see note)*

> **Note:** Nagareru appears under Path Games above; if flow/movement is preferred it may shift to Category 7. Each game appears in one category only as listed.
